# Baseshire Hethaway — Crypto Conglomerate
Liquidity for illiquid digital assets. NFT-backed lending, mini-app sales, X handle transfers, and Farcaster FID escrow.

## Pages
- / — Landing (market overview, feed, categories)
- /market — NFT Loans marketplace (browse + list NFT-backed loans)
- /miniapps — Mini Apps marketplace (browse + list apps/websites for sale)
- /x — X Accounts marketplace (browse + list X handles through escrow)
- /farcaster — Farcaster marketplace (browse + list FID accounts)
- /clanker — Clanker Tokens marketplace (browse + list token offerings)
- /deals — Profile (active deals, deal room, encrypted chat)
- /detail — Loan detail page for individual listing inspection and counter-offers

## Admin
- /admin/dash — Admin dashboard (system overview, metrics)
- /admin/disputes — Dispute queue management
- /admin/listings — Listing moderation
- /admin/users — User management
- /admin/admin-escrow — Escrow operations (release/refund/dispute)
- /admin/tickets — Support inbox
- /admin/audit — Audit log viewer

## Architecture
- Next.js 16 App Router with React 19
- Neon serverless Postgres + Drizzle ORM
- CSS custom properties theming (light/dark, solid/glass, compact/regular/comfortable)
- viem + SIWE wallet auth with Base chain escrow smart contract
- AES-256-GCM encrypted chat per deal
